scope: Local Tessellate Docker runtime on the owner's laptop

services.name: tessellate-laptop-api-1

before.localHealthRequest: GET http://127.0.0.1:8788/health failed with fetch failed

services.action: Restarted existing API container with docker compose restart api; no image rebuild.

services.name: tessellate-laptop-host-1

before.dockerHealthcheck: host heartbeat timestamp was not updated within 20 seconds

services.action: After the API was healthy, restarted the existing host container with docker compose restart host; no image rebuild.

impact: Laptop inference and host-dependent operations were unavailable while the API was unhealthy and the host heartbeat was stale. Deterministic browser composition and the public Site were not changed.
rootCauseStatus: The proximate failure is confirmed: the API health endpoint was unreachable while Docker kept the container running, and the host heartbeat expired. The initiating cause of the API server becoming unresponsive is unknown; restart restored service. No application source change is claimed.
actionsAvoided: No MGI containers were restarted or modified.
No secret values or provider credentials were read, printed, or changed.
No container image was rebuilt from the dirty working tree.
